metadata.qos: goal/result/cancel/feedback reliable volatile KeepLast(max(16, goal_window*feedback_per_goal)); status native defaults; result retention 10 s
metadata.transport: independent processes, localhost DDS, intra-process disabled
metadata.scheduling: single-threaded executor/spin loop; 100 ms wait cap; goal_window active goals
metadata.protocol: accept goal window sequentially; readiness phase 0; server publishes round-robin feedback; client validates all payloads and sends phase 1 ACK; server succeeds every result; final rejected control goal
metadata.rtt_boundary: before first goal submission through all accepted goals, readiness handshake, all validated feedback, acknowledgement and all successful results
metadata.feedback_boundary: before readiness phase 0 request through complete validated round-robin feedback consumption
metadata.throughput_boundary: all measured batches including full payload validation; excludes discovery, warmup and final control

instrumentation.scope: process-wide allocation entry points and getrusage during measured windows; Rust future wakes only
